about: What a story is made of in Explorer Harbor's room, Make a story: who it is about, where it happens, what they want, what goes wrong and how it comes right. Six beginnings, each with two things that can go wrong, each of those with two ways it can come right: twenty-four ways through for every one of the three it can be about. Every way ends well. Nothing here is right or wrong to choose.

no-wind.name: The wind stops
no-wind.but: But the wind stopped, and the kite fell down.

run.name: Run with it
run.so: So it was time to run! Along the sand, as fast as the wind, and up went the kite.

wait.name: Wait for the wind
wait.so: So there was nothing to do but wait. Then the wind came back, and up went the kite.

tangle.name: The string is in a tangle
tangle.but: But the string was all in a tangle.

crab.name: A crab snips the knots
crab.so: Along came a little crab. Snip, snip, and the knots were gone. Up went the kite.

slowly.name: Undo the knots one by one
slowly.so: Slowly, slowly, one knot at a time, the string came free. Up went the kite.

wave.name: A wave washes it away
wave.but: But a big wave came, and washed the castle away.

higher.name: Build it higher up the beach
higher.so: So a new castle was built, high up the beach, where no wave could reach.

ditch.name: Dig a ditch round it
ditch.so: So a ditch was dug all round a new castle. The next wave filled the ditch, and the castle stood.

dry.name: The sand is too dry
dry.but: But the sand was too dry, and the castle fell down.

bucket.name: Fetch a bucket of water
bucket.so: A bucket of sea water made the sand wet, and the new castle stood up tall.

dig.name: Dig down to the wet sand
dig.so: Deep down, the sand was wet. That sand made a castle that stood up tall.

high.name: The berries are too high
high.but: But the best berries were too high to reach.

log.name: Stand on a log
log.so: So a log was rolled under the bush. One step up, and the basket was full.

stick.name: Pull the branch down with a stick
stick.so: A long stick pulled the branch down low, and soon the basket was full.

hole.name: The basket has a hole
hole.but: But the basket had a hole, and the berries fell out.

leaf.name: Mend it with a leaf
leaf.so: A big leaf went into the basket, over the hole. Not one more berry fell out.

eat.name: Eat them straight away
eat.so: So the berries were eaten then and there. Yum, yum, yum!

stream.name: Cross the stream
stream.want: wanted to get across the stream

broken.name: The bridge is broken
broken.but: But the little bridge was broken.

stones.name: Step across on the stones
stones.so: Three flat stones lay in the water. Step, step, step, and over the stream.

log.name: Lay a log across
log.so: A fallen log lay near. Pushed across the water, it made a new bridge.

deep.name: The water is too deep
deep.but: But the water was too deep to walk across.

along.name: Find where it is not deep
along.so: A little way along, it was not deep at all. Splash, splash, and over the stream.

boat.name: Row across in a boat
boat.so: A little boat was tied to a tree. Row, row, row, and over the stream.

rain.name: It begins to rain
rain.but: But then it began to rain.

tree.name: Sit under the big tree
tree.so: Under the big tree it was dry. The picnic was eaten there, to the sound of the rain.

umbrella.name: Put up an umbrella
umbrella.so: Up went a big umbrella, and the picnic stayed dry.

ants.name: Ants come for the cake
ants.but: But a line of ants came marching for the cake.

share.name: Give every ant a crumb
share.so: So every ant was given a crumb, and there was plenty of cake for all.

move.name: Move to the top of the hill
move.so: So the picnic was moved to the top of the hill, and the ants went home.

apple.name: Get the big red apple
apple.want: wanted the big red apple at the top of the tree

high.name: The apple is too high
high.but: But the apple was much too high to reach.

ladder.name: Climb a ladder
ladder.so: A ladder stood by the shed. Up, up, up, and the apple was picked.

shake.name: Shake the tree gently
shake.so: One gentle shake of the tree, and down came the apple, plop, into the grass.

rolled.name: The apple rolls away
rolled.but: But the apple fell, and rolled away down the hill.

chase.name: Run after it
chase.so: After it! Down the hill and round the pond, and there was the apple, by the gate.

duck.name: A duck brings it back
duck.so: It rolled all the way to the pond. A duck pushed it back to the bank with its beak.

asks.who: Let us make a story. Who is it about?
asks.trouble: Oh dear. Something goes wrong. What is it?
asks.told: Here is your story, from the beginning.
asks.whole: That is your story. You can hear it again, or make a new one.
